  • Predatory Instincts  Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.
    Rank 1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 10% and increases your spell healing by 12% of your Intellect.
    Rank 2: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.
    • NEW Effect #2 Apply Aura: Mod Healing Power by % of Stat: Modifies Effect #1's Value
      Value: 25
    Name changed from Predatory Instincts to Natural Instinct
  • Thick Hide  While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3180 additional base Armor per level and another 1.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.
    Rank 1: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 1180 additional base Armor per level and another 0.67 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.
    Rank 2: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 2180 additional base Armor per level and another 1.33 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.
    Rank 3: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3180 additional base Armor per level and another 2.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

title.es: Pérdida de durabilidad por penalización de resurrección reducida en WoW: Forever Beta Build 4

summary.en: Durability Loss from Resurrection Penalty Reduced in WoW: Forever Beta Build 4...
summary.es: Pérdida de durabilidad por penalización de resurrección reducida en WoW: Forever Beta Build 4...

contentHtml:
In the latest build of WoW: Forever Beta, the penalty for resurrecting at a Spirit Healer has been reduced.

The WoW: Forever Beta is now on its 4th build and we've datamined a change to the Resurrection penalty when you decide to revive at a Spirit Healer. While players who don't run to their corpse will still get Resurrection Sickness, the durability loss has been reduced to 25% (was 50%):
  • Resurrecting at a Spirit Healer will now incur 25% durability damage, instead of 50%.
This will make it slightly less punishing for players who use the Spirit Healer, but you'll still incur Resurrection Sickness, weakening your character's strength for a short amount of time.

title.en: Changes to Racials Likely Coming Next Week in WoW: Forever
title.es: Los cambios raciales probablemente llegarán la próxima semana en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Changes to Racials Likely Coming Next Week in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Los cambios raciales probablemente llegarán la próxima semana en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
In the most recent episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Aggrend has announced that changes to racial abilities are to coming, and that we should expect to see them in next week's beta update.



Racial abilities have been an incredibly hot topic in WoW Forever. When comparing certain races' unique abilities, such as a Dwarf to an Orc, it seems almost incomparable. Common complaints from the community have been how strong Orc racial abilities are in general, and when Dwarves are the only race on the Alliance that can be Shaman, it also causes some issues with overall faction balance.
Aggrend said:
"Looking at things like actives such as the Orc and the Troll abilities and how strong they are, perhaps a little too strong, also things like weapon skill abilities... Do we want to keep those or do we want to replace those with something else?"
As Aggrend mentioned, Troll and Orc active racials like Berserking and Blood Fury have been seen as incredibly strong with the rest of their combined racial abilities and passives. It's been seen by the community that overall, Horde racials seem to outpower Alliance, and we may see some balancing next week.

summary.es: Es probable que Mazmorra Maps no llegue a WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Dungeon maps are probably not coming to World of Warcraft: Forever due to design philosophies.

WoW: Forever Podcast - Ep. 3


In today's episode of The WoW Forever Podcast, the panel discussed Dungeon Maps. Amongst the community, some players have requested dungeon maps so that they can more easily explore the dungeon and complete the dungeon faster, while others enjoy the sense of exploration. Jay Hartman, Senior Game Designer, comments on dungeon maps and their philosophy:
Jay Hartman said:
You mentioned dungeon maps. I think I've seen a couple questions and comments about it, and I think this philosophy that we have reinforces why we don't have dungeon maps. We want you to feel like it's an adventure and it's threatening and we want you to explore those nooks and crannies. If you have a dungeon map, people find the shortest route possible and try to avoid stuff. We want to try to incentivize you to go explore [...] This is a good reason of why we probably won't have dungeon maps because of all of these things.
From this, it seems like Dungeon maps will not be coming to WoW: Forever anytime soon. After the buffs to dungeon experience, it'll be interesting to see if players are still requesting dungeon maps to be added.

summary.en: BCCA: Face the Gods of Zul’Aman on October 22 — World of Warcraft — Blizzard News...
summary.es: BCCA: Enfréntate a los dioses de Zul'Aman el 22 de octubre — World of Warcraft — Blizzard News...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced that Zul'Aman will be released on October 22nd for the Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary servers!
Blizzard
View Original
Gather your allies and venture into the Eastern Kingdoms, where the dangers of Zul'Aman await.
Global Launch : October 22 at 3:00 p.m. PDT / 23:00 BST
Just south of the once beautiful elven kingdom of Quel'Thalas, the eerie Ghostlands beckon brave adventurers, daring them to enter the Amani stronghold of Zul'Aman.

Storm Zul’Aman and Confront Zul’jin

For millennia, Zul'Aman has stood as the Amani trolls' seat of power and the bastion of their fearless, cunning warlord, Zul'jin. Behind its walls, he has spent years plotting his vengeance.

There, Zul’jin seeks to seal the power of the animal gods within the tribe’s strongest warriors. Enter the stronghold, defeat the devious warlord, and stop him from exacting his deadly vengeance.

Raid bosses : Nalorakk, Akil'zon, Jan'alai, Halazzi, Hex Lord Malacrass, and Zul'jin
Level : 70
Location : Ghostlands, Eastern Kingdoms
Good to Know : No attunement is required to enter the instance. Zul’Aman has a 3-day reset lockout.

Gather nine of your staunchest allies and brave the dangers at the heart of Zul’Aman to claim the stronghold’s treasures.

Furious at the Horde for allowing his hated enemies, the blood elves, to join its ranks, Zul’jin eagerly embraced the witch doctor Malacrass’s scheme. Will time be on your side as you battle through Zul’Aman and bring their plan to an end?

Race the Clock to Claim the Amani War Bear


Zul’jin and his lieutenants are holding several hostages in Zul’Aman. As soon as you and your raid breach the gates, the Amani will begin preparing to execute them.

Rescue all the hostages before time runs out, and your raid will earn the rare Amani War Bear battle mount.

Each time you defeat one of Zul’jin’s lieutenants and rescue a hostage, you will earn additional loot and extend the timer, giving your raid more time to rescue the remaining hostages.

Beyond Zul’Aman

  • Doomlord Kazzak and Doomwalker are now more eager to share their spoils. Their loot is now Bind on Equip (from Bind on Pickup).
  • The Battle for Mount Hyjal and The Black Temple will no longer require attunement to enter.
  • The reputation requirement to purchase Heroic dungeon keys has been reduced to Honored.
  • All Heroic dungeons will be adjusted to their final, reduced difficulty state.

Badges of Justice

The following bosses can now drop Badges of Justice, giving you more opportunities to obtain this valuable currency:
  • Doomlord Kazzak and Doomwalker
  • All bosses in Karazhan, Gruul's Lair, and Magtheridon's Lair
  • All bosses in Serpentshrine Cavern and Tempest Keep
  • All bosses in Zul'Aman
In addition, G’eras in Shattrath now offers more powerful wares in exchange for Badges of Justice, including Nether Vortex.

Epic Gem Updates

Magtheridon’s Black Sack of Gems and Jewelcrafter’s Brilliant Glass can now contain epic gems. Please note that existing Brilliant Glasses and previously looted, unopened Black Sack of Gems will not contain epic gems.

Additional Updates

  • Outland faction vendors will offer Leatherworking recipes for Greater Drums, Knothide Quiver, and Knothide Ammo Pouch.
  • Primal Nether and Nether Vortex will no longer be soulbound.
Zul'Aman's army grows stronger by the day, driven by its hunger for vengeance in Zul'jin’s name. Enter the stronghold and put an end to his plans.

contentHtml:
A new fall-themed mount has been added to the in-game shop, and this adorable Whoofle Bramblewing is sure to captivate.

An adorable face, autumn leaves, and a brand-new mount trailer - this little guy has it all! The new mount is the standard price of $25 USD, but the in-game shop may be having loading issues. If you're determined to buy him right now, you can find him on the web-based shop here:

Whoofle Bramblewing Mount






Blizzard
View Original
Swoop over the treetops or scamper across the countryside in the saddle of Whoofle Bramblewing*. With bright eyes, ruffled feathers, and keen curiosity, this inquisitive owl eagerly seeks out hidden wonders and untrodden paths wherever they may lead.
Visit the Shop
This mount is shared across all present and future characters in modern World of Warcraft® (currently Midnight™) and automatically scales to each character's fastest riding skill. If an adventurer isn't ready to take to the skies yet, Whoofle Bramblewing serves as a wise, watchful ground mount until the time comes to spread their wings.
Purchase Whoofle Bramblewing today through the in-game Shop or at Battle.net. Some restrictions apply, so visit the shop for full details.

*Not available in World of Warcraft Classic® games and requires a World of Warcraft® subscription or Game Time.
